raw: {"verdict": "fail", "reason": "The cancel() handler only calls sub.unsubscribe(), which removes the channel subscription but leaves the duplicated ioredis connection open, so the connection leak the issue describes persists; it needs sub.quit() or disconnect(). Also, if the client disconnects while the heartbeat/message callbacks are firing, enqueue on a closed controller can throw, and the sub.on('message') listener is not removed."}
